author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Procreate Illustrator for Coloring Pages
content: A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY! I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! ... 2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR. I require someone creative who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs for me. These will be very very simple bold and easy designs to begin with and will grow in complexity over time. You will not be required to draw from scratch - I will provide you will all of my coloring pages and you will be required to add a hand drawn finess to the pages provided using PROCREATE. If you are interested ... please send me a DM and we can have a chat more specifically about what I am looking for. You will be required to send me an example of work even if you have never done this before. You will also be required to send me your proposed fee for this. I require a proposed fee per video and per 5 pages of hand finished illustrations.
